notes: Player feedback fixes: supported stair landing with roof clearance, finished loft ceilings, better wardrobe and sconce placement, and a serving table that clears the wall. Lodgers now lie on their beds. A 24-item kitchen pantry saves prepared food and supplies; cooking stations offer recipe and ingredient selection with empty-handed E. Ferris's wagon sells supplies after hours. Safer mug drops avoid stacking and preserve blocked items, with retained placement shaders to prevent runtime input errors.
